name: Huangjin de lichengbei
source:
An empire drowning in war, rotting from decadence, and built on the backs of slaves.

When the flames of war consume your homeland, you are stripped of your nobility. By a cruel twist of fate, you are sold into slavery and dragged to the capital.

There, you will cross paths with three gladiators. Choose the gladiator you will serve, forge an unbreakable bond, and face the storm brewing in the shadows of the empire.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4491390/Miliarium/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个淹没在战争中、因颓废而腐烂、建立在奴隶之上的帝国。

当战火吞噬你的祖国时，你就被剥夺了高贵。由于命运的残酷扭曲，你被卖为奴隶并被拖到首都。

在那里，你将与三名角斗士相遇。选择你将侍奉的角斗士，建立牢不可破的联系，并面对帝国阴影中酝酿的风暴。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4491390/Miliarium/]Steam[/url]]
